clauses.quote: A resident special subject Teacher, who is reassigned as an itinerant special subject Teacher, if subsequently reassigned as a resident special subject Teacher, will carry over the building seniority accumulated in the resident assignment immediately preceding the itinerant assignment.

A Teacher who remains in a building and is appointed by the DCPS Office of Human Resources to a position in another area of certification shall have his/her building seniority in that area of certification counted from the date of appointme
